name: MSFC Technical Standard 3012A — Nonconformance Reporting and Disposition
description: Marshall Space Flight Center standard governing the reporting, disposition, and closure of manufacturing nonconformances.

rules.title: NCR creation timing
rules.text: Nonconformances shall be recorded in an NCR within the operating shift in which they are discovered; delayed recording is itself a nonconformance.

rules.title: Disposition authority
rules.text: Use-as-is and repair dispositions require Material Review Board concurrence; return-to-vendor and scrap may be dispositioned by QA alone but shall be recorded with engineering cognizance.

rules.title: Separation of duties for closure
rules.text: The qualified QA approver who closes an NCR shall not be the same individual who dispositioned it; this separation is a mandatory control and cannot be overridden.
